summary.en: Turn available wall space into an open display arrangement.
summary.zh: 利用墙面空间布置开放展示与收纳。

description.en:
A wall-shelf arrangement with several open compartments for books, small objects and decorative items. The offset layout gives you a starting point for planning a feature wall without a floor-standing unit.
Confirm the overall size, shelf depth, materials, fixing method and required load specification before ordering.
description.zh:
多个开放格可用于摆放书籍、小物件与装饰品，错落布局便于规划不占地面位置的展示墙。
下单前请核对整体尺寸、隔板深度、材料、固定方式及所需承重规格。

en: Open compartments in an offset wall arrangement.
Display surfaces for books and decorative objects.
Fixing method and load requirements confirmed for the selected model.
zh: 错落布置的墙面开放格。
可用于书籍与装饰物展示。
固定方式及承重需求按所选款式确认。

applications.en: Living rooms, study spaces and display walls
applications.zh: 客厅、学习空间及展示墙
